overview_description.description:
Optimism is an Ethereum-based decentralized infrastructure platform that allows for instant transactions and scalable smart contracts. The company is a public benefit corporation, a for-profit corporation that is obligated to balance the financial interests of our stockholders with the best interests of our community and society.

Optimism, which was founded in 2019 and is based in New York, provides an Ethereum layer 2 scaling solution to assist developers in building on the blockchain.

product.name: OP Stack
product.description: An open-source development stack that powers OP Mainnet and other blockchain protocols, enabling deployment of Layer 2 chains.

product.name: OP Mainnet
product.description: A decentralized Layer 2 rollup protocol on Ethereum that supports instant transactions and scalable smart contracts.

product.name: Optimism Gateway Interface (Bridge)
product.description: A web interface that enables users to bridge digital assets between Ethereum, OP Mainnet, and other blockchains.

product.name: Optimist NFT Service
product.description: A service enabling eligible users to mint non-transferable NFTs with customizable profile pictures on OP Mainnet.

product.name: Optimism Collective Governance
product.description: A decentralized governance model where members decide on Optimism’s economy, technology, and governance development.

product.name: Retroactive Public Goods Funding (RetroPGF)
product.description: A funding mechanism that rewards projects and individuals contributing positive impact to the Optimism ecosystem.
